intent.summary: Cure the user-visible bugs the 2026-11-09/10 sessions lived through and restore archive integrity: changelog same-day obligation across UTC midnight (#49), changelog validator rejecting #N issue tokens that blocks closing keywords (#24), between-tasks gate false-red on DONE-resident state (concern dffa50f0), census fresh-checkout optional-entry class (concern 73cef6ab), the fromCommit archive path skipping the completed_at stamp plus the deficient -der archive payload rebuild and one-time retro-stamp, the --help short-circuit, and a phase rename verb so project.json name edits never need hand edits again.

requirements.text: Cure the user-visible bugs the 2026-11-09/10 sessions lived through and restore archive integrity: changelog same-day...
Obligation = structural delta: batch diff adds >=1 Unreleased bullet; bases: CI parent / PR merge-base / SHIP task_head; lint format-only; predicates unified
Closing keywords ride the PR body: neutralizer unchanged; #N groups legal; archive push hint + ceremony teach the PR flow
completed_at cure: commit chain merges archive disk-writes; idle + tid idempotency re-key to tid-in-archive; slug keeps stamp
-der repair: task/1a2e46f3 rebuilt from 493a9e7 + retro-stamp + PROVENANCE; roster concern; siblings untouched
help-flag short-circuit: any --help/-h in argv routes to help without executing; write-class included
gos phase rename <n> <name>: pending-only; active/done/parked refused; views re-rendered
Census optional entries: optional:true = valid-if-absent; .gos/cache optional; validator honors it; ci mkdir hotfix removed
Dig floor: decisions carry dig evidence in state; spec freeze refuses decisions without it
